title: Served record
description: A harness plugin's binding of a thread to the harness's own thread ID, two per received prompt; on TRACE.{account}.edges, signed (afo-design.md §8.3). Written by the OpenClaw plugin since 2026-09-15, expected from Claude Code's; PI stamps the SDK's headers on its own calls and writes none.

version.description: schema version of this record kind; additive changes bump it, breaking changes are a new subject

record_id.description: the Agent-Sender nonce for this signed record; also the Nats-Msg-Id

agent.description: the plugin's own AgentId — the executing agent

thread_id.description: from the envelope, or minted by the plugin when the envelope carried none

root_id.description: 128-bit random, lower-case hex, minted by the caller at prompt()

harness_thread_id.description: the harness's own thread ID, bare, the same string the proxy writes as harness_thread_id on the calls it files under it (afo-design.md §8.1): claude — {session}; openclaw — the 32-hex trace ID. Proposed 2026-09-17; until then claude:{session}, openclaw:{trace id}, with the prefix

$comment: Standing since 2026-09-16: the OpenClaw plugin writes it (afo-design.md §8.3); harness is claude or openclaw since decision 26. Proposed 2026-09-17 (Francesco): harness_thread_id bare, the thread record carrying the same pair, so the reader joins the two by equality.
